Create rocket_plane_airframe part for mission mega-8-fc-rocket-20260714 (DL1).

Geometry from ledger dimensions (all mm):
- Body tube: OD 60, ID 56 (wall 2.0), overall length ~450
- Layout along +Z (nose at +Z): nose_cone_length 90 + payload_bay_length 100 + midbody 80 + motor/fin region 180 = 450
- Payload bay: internal clear L=100 mm, ID=56 mm — this is the FC board cavity. Provide a flat mounting shelf/rails inside the bay for a 50x50 mm board, centered on body axis, board plane on XY (or offset slightly for CG). Leave sensor FOV/antenna keepouts: top of bay open or vented for baro; nose-forward GPS FOV clear; board not buried in solid wall.
- Fins: 3 or 4 fins, root chord 80 mm on motor/fin region, span ~60–80 mm, thickness ~2–3 mm, evenly spaced around body.
- Wing/glide surface: modest boost-glide wing (span ~200–300 mm total, chord ~80–100 mm) midbody or aft of payload bay; dihedral optional; thickness ~2–3 mm.
- Material/process context: PLA FDM (do not invent loads).

Requirements:
- Editable feature tree (sketches constrained, extrudes, etc.)
- verify_battery PASS before you hand off
- Record key dims and interface planes in ledger_note
- Name the doc something like rocket_plane_airframe
- Payload bay must accept 50x50x~8 mm FC envelope with radial clearance (body ID 56 vs board diagonal ~70.7 is tight — board is 50 mm wide so max board width fits as 50 < 56; place board flat, centered, long axis along body Z if board is square 50x50).

Return: doc_id, body names, payload-bay interface face/axis descriptions for mating, verify_battery summary, any keepout notes.
